text_block_list.text: Several days have passed since "DREAMS" was launched—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed.
...Though it seems they're getting a bit out of breath.
choice_data_list: Shall we take a break soon?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
However, there is no need to worry. This too is—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Someday, to reach that point...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Very good.
Your motivation is simply impeccable.
choice_data_list: You pick things up quickly, I think you've got good instincts.

text_block_list.text:
She has a slight tendency to jump the gun, but her natural skill
is genuinely impressive. Depending on how well she manages her motivation,
she should see massive growth.
choice_data_list: Her training policy focuses on mental strength, I guess

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes, achieving great things begins with passion.
Let us keep that in mind during coaching as well.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: (However... Hmm. "Attaining"... what does that mean?)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Phew... Kgh, nrgh...! Not yet... Not yet...!
choice_data_list: Okay, stop. Let's take a breath and catch our breath first.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Wonderful effort. And to think this project has only just gotten underway.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Your enthusiasm toward training
is particularly remarkable."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much.
However, this is all for the sake of reaching "that place."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, I was a little curious.
What exactly do phrases like 'that place'
or 'attaining' mean to you—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Are you really that curious about it...!?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... It's only natural. Anyone would get
curious after hearing a story like that.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now is the time to confess...
What 'that place' truly is—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A dazzling, extraordinary world,
worthy of one day being reached by me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Somewhere far away, somewhere not here—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: All our daily training... is a trial to reach that unseen place...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu... Pardon me.
It seems I got a bit carried away."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's resume shortly.
I've finished rehydrating now.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
At first, I thought "that place" she spoke of
referred to a physical location, but—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Perhaps it is a method of self-actualization based on some sort of mythology.
choice_data_list: Everyone has their own source of motivation, after all.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. When motivation is high,
that's the time to push for growth. I'm looking forward to seeing their progress!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —So then, what questions does the esteemed reporter have for me?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
“—Well, no, I was just wondering how it actually is.
You know, your impressions regarding this challenge.”

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My impressions? Naturally...
I feel it is a wonderful project.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes... indeed.
The BC is a world-class festival of GⅠ races.
Victory brings eternal glory that echoes through generations...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text: "However, the fact remains... that no Japanese Umamusume has ever overcome this and won."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...
Those who have been called 'special' until now are—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
She has overcome walls that ordinary people would deem impossible.
That is precisely what makes her "special."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: The track records, the winning streaks. As well as the many great feats that you, dear reporter, have likely witnessed over the years.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It is something achieved when a "special" someone
shatters the common sense of what was thought impossible or beyond human limits.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
To achieve what no one thinks possible.
That is precisely the destiny imposed upon the "special" ones.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: That is why—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It is inevitable that I shall win the Breeders' Cup,
which the esteemed press deems impossible. Because—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I am a saint, after all!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text: A-A saint... you say?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The saint of the "world beyond this one"...
where I shall one day arrive.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "A presence that illuminates the entire world with its radiance... That is the holy maiden, Red Desire."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Could there be anything that the Saint,
burdened with such a grand destiny, cannot overcome?
No, there is nothing!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Before long, I shall overcome
even the barrier of the world itself!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If she is truly that "special" of a being...
then reaching the world's sole pinnacle is only inevitable!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: In other words... taking on the BC is, to me—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
These are all the trials of a saint to be overcome
on the path to "that sacred place"! It is by no means impossible!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: If I close my eyes, I can see the scene of cutting through the wind. If I listen closely, I can hear the cheers of the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
――Haha. That was quite an unexpected answer.
Yet your eyes and your words are completely sincere.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
So much so that I couldn't help but envision you
racing in the lead at the Breeders' Cup.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Rather than assuming something you've never seen is "impossible"—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Please have faith and think, 'If it is that Saint, Red Desire...'

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Do so, and as a Saint, I shall illuminate even your heart, dear reporter,
with the light of hope. Through my victory in the BC.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Two and a half years from now, is it? I find myself looking forward... just a little, to the outcome of the Saint's tale.
...Enough that I almost want to cheer for it.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ...Desire-san.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My, good work!
I was just speaking with the reporters about how deeply meaningful taking on the BC challenge is.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, I heard you.
That was a splendid presentation.
choice_data_list: I think your feelings got through to the reporters too.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes. I believe so too. I'm sure you now understand that I am worthy of challenging the BC.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's true.
The BC is truly befitting of someone with convictions as strong as yours. For you see—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"From the very first time it was held until today,
the BC has always been the American Dream of the racing world――"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Because it's a place where those who believe in and hone the "specialness" hidden within their own legs can seize their dreams.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
The "promised land" you long for...
I believe it lies just beyond there, too.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
That is why you, too, have earned the right to desire it
and reach for it, just like those who came before you, Desire-san.
choice_data_list: And we're here to pave that path.
And we're here to pave that path.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Perhaps this, too, is destiny.
My gratitude to you both.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"When I finally reach 'that place,'
I will surely illuminate you both with the holy maiden's light!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now, I can't just stand around doing nothing!
I must dedicate myself to training today as well...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. She really is a curious Umamusume, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
While envisioning a fantasy-like self-actualization,
a resolute will keeps your feet firmly planted on the ground.
choice_data_list: Maybe that's the power of the "Saint."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right.
Shall we go and pave the way as well, then?

Watching their back as they ran toward "that place,"
I began preparing for today's training.
